title: AI Red Team Specialist - LLM
description:

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark , General Catalyst , Peter Thiel , Adam D'Angelo , Larry Summers , and Jack Dorsey .
Position: LLM Red Team Specialist - Failure Modes & Edge Cases
Type: Contract
Compensation: $60-$90/hour
Location: Remote
Commitment: 35 hours/week
Role Responsibilities

•
Probe models to explore how frontier AI models handle coding , ML , and analysis tasks. Identify spots where models quietly fail.

•
Design challenges by turning identified weaknesses into well-crafted tasks that are challenging for models but fair to grade.

•
Document findings clearly with reproducible evidence and steps.

•
Strengthen tasks by collaborating with task authors to close loopholes, shortcuts, and grading gaps.

•
Work as a team by sharing insights with researchers and fellow experts to continually improve the benchmark.

Qualifications

Must-Have

• MSc or PhD in a STEM field or equivalent practical experience.

• 1+ years of experience in research, research-engineering, security, or AI-evaluation roles.

• Ability to identify vulnerabilities, edge cases, or failure modes in LLMs or ML systems .

• Proficiency in Python and Git for scripting probes and analyses.

• Familiarity with LLM capabilities , limitations, and evaluation techniques.

• Ability to engage reliably for approximately 35 hours/week .

Preferred

• Experience in AI training , model evaluation, or benchmark/task authoring.

• High attention to detail, creativity, and strong written communication skills.

title: Marketing Systems & Growth Architect
description:
Category: Marketing

Location:

This is a systems-first, hands-on role responsible for transforming our CRM and marketing automation ecosystem into a clean, scalable, revenue-driving engine. This is not a brand marketing or campaign execution role. This is a technical marketing systems leadership position focused on structure, integrity, and long-term scalability.

About My Amazon Guy

My Amazon Guy (MAG) is a full-service Amazon growth agency helping established Amazon sellers ($40K-$10M+ revenue) optimize, scale, and professionalize their Amazon businesses.

We generate leads through authority-driven content (YouTube, LinkedIn, SEO), paid media (Google & Meta), outbound ASIN review videos, and our Free Audit offer.

MAG is a thriving digital marketing agency with 500+ employees and a diverse global client base. Our culture is dynamic, performance-driven, and built around innovation and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

•
HubSpot Architecture & Governance

• Conduct a full audit of properties, workflows, lists, lifecycle stages, and automation logic

• Remove deprecated workflows and redundant structures

• Deduplicate contacts and companies

• Redesign lifecycle stages for clarity and reporting integrity

• Implement clean segmentation logic

• Establish naming conventions and governance standards

• Restrict permissions and prevent ad hoc workflow creation

• Document system architecture and operational processes

•
Lifecycle Marketing & Automation

• Build structured lifecycle segments (Lead, MQL, SQL, Opportunity, Customer)

• Develop dynamic segmentation frameworks based on intent and readiness

• Design and optimize automated nurture journeys

• Align marketing automation with sales handoff rules

• Eliminate unnecessary broadcast email volume

• Ensure all workflows are tied to measurable revenue movement

•
BDR & Marketing Alignment

• Align outbound outreach (ASIN review videos and follow-ups) with automation logic

• Prevent overlapping or contradictory messaging

• Ensure intent signals trigger correct actions

• Maintain clean routing and lifecycle transitions

• Connect human sales outreach with automation systems

•
Attribution & Funnel Clarity

• Work across platforms including:

• HubSpot (CRM)

• ActiveCampaign

• Instantly

• Google Ads

• Meta Ads

• Retention.com

• WordPress

• GA4

• Google Tag Manager

• Google Search Console

• Google Business Profile

• Trustpilot

• You will:

• Standardize UTM governance

• Improve multi-touch attribution visibility

• Align ad reporting with lifecycle progression

• Improve MQL → SQL → Opportunity tracking

• Reduce reporting ambiguity for leadership

•
Marketing Infrastructure Protection

• Create segmentation request protocols

• Establish automation standards

• Protect system integrity from short-term workarounds

• Maintain documentation and system clarity

• Serve as long-term owner of marketing systems governance

Requirements

• 5+ years in Marketing Operations, RevOps, or Marketing Technology

• Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience (required)

• Proven experience cleaning and restructuring complex CRM environments

• Strong understanding of paid media funnels and conversion tracking

• Experience with lifecycle marketing, lead scoring, and segmentation frameworks

• Experience building or restructuring automation systems

• Comfortable enforcing governance and setting system standards

• Experience working with distributed teams (Filipino team experience preferred)

• A dual-monitor setup is required (at least 8GB of RAM)

• Must have at least 25 MBPS internet speed

Benefits

• 40 hours a week, 8 hours a day

• Competitive salary base

• Permanent WFH setup

• Unlimited FREE access to MAG School courses and SOP Library!

title: NodeJS Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Kiddie Kredit

Our startup has raised a pre-seed round and is looking to hire engineers for exciting, unique projects. As an early member of the engineering team you will have input on decisions and a lot of potential impact.

This position is fully remote and available to anyone within 3 hours of US EST time zone.

Our Team

Our team is an all-star cast composed of a CEO who has won multiple pitch competitions and been accepted into several accelerators, a CMO who has developed several web properties with millions of users each, and a CTO who was a team lead at AWS and has experience building systems that can stand up to 40 million requests per hour.

Our Product

We are a B2B2C platform and have some very powerful strategic partners. Our most exciting opportunities involve our partnerships with Equifax and YMCA Atlanta in order to add business-level integrations to our consumer app.

Our Stack

MongoDB Atlas, Node, React, React Native, identity with Auth0, JavaScript, Typescript, and AWS. Heavily using infrastructure as code.

Job Qualifications

• You are able to work full time, within 3 hours of US EST time zone.

• At least 3 years of experience as a paid software engineer working at a company where the primary product is software, or working at a software development agency. This is not negotiable.

- Deep knowledge of Javascript

• Understanding of http and server technologies

- Knowledge of ReactJS

- Computer Science background

• Excellent written English, and basic conversational English (our CTO speaks Spanish but we want code written in English and we want to be able to communicate in English during team meetings)

The ideal candidate

The skill we value and need the most is the ability to understand product requirements and translate them into working code while aligning with business goals. When the product team asks for something in a two month timeline that would take over a year to build, you should be able to push back and negotiate. You should be able to ask questions like

• How do we solve this customer need and validate our assumptions without building all this custom software?

• Is there a pre-existing saas we can use in order to implement this whole subsystem?

• Can we get rid of this feature entirely?

The day-to-day of the job

At a high level, you will be the chief system designer, provide mentorship to other devs, and be the bridge between product requirements and the business team.

title: Lifecycle Marketing Lead
description:
About Bobbie

Bobbie makes European-style organic infant formula manufactured end-to-end in the U.S., because we believe every parent deserves to feed their baby with confidence, without judgment and without compromise. No mystery ingredients. No shortcuts. Just clean, thoughtfully made formula that parents can trust.

But Bobbie has never been just a formula company. When the 2022 national infant formula shortage left parents across the country unable to feed their babies, we closed our storefront to new customers rather than leave a single existing family without formula. We went to Washington. We got loud. And we opened our Heath, Ohio manufacturing facility to make sure something like that could never happen again.

That's who we are, and that's what you'd be joining.

Bobbie for Change

Our advocacy arm, Bobbie for Change, exists because making great formula isn't enough if the systems around parenthood are still broken. We fight for paid federal parental leave, push for legislation to prevent future formula shortages, advocate for feeding equity, and support families navigating impossible situations, including donating formula to parents impacted by breast and gynecologic cancers through the Bobbie Breasties program.

We're a company that genuinely believes becoming a parent makes you an activist. The people who work here feel that too.

About the Role
Bobbie is looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Lead (equivalent to senior manager) to help drive retention strategy across the full path to purchase. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role covering the channels and moments that shape how Bobbie communicates with parents throughout their journey, from email and SMS to on-site personalization, retargeting, loyalty, and CX-driven touchpoints. Success will show up in list growth, acquisition, and revenue from repeat customers.

You'll report into the Director of Lifecycle, supporting our lifecycle roadmap and retention strategy across channels, while owning key functional projects and launches end to end. As a recognized subject matter expert, you'll act as a thought partner, with a deep understanding of the Bobbie customer experience across every touchpoint.
We're looking for someone who is an expert in SMS and email, with experience operating additional lifecycle channels, and who wants to help keep Bobbie on the cutting edge of lifecycle marketing.
What You'll Do
Strategy & Ownership

• Partner with the Director on our lifecycle roadmap, owning execution of growth and retention strategy across email, SMS, in-box, and beyond, and converting more one-time purchasers into subscribers

• Bring deep SMS expertise to the table and show up as a proactive, vocal partner in cross-functional workstreams

• Help support owning our lifecycle programs end-to-end, covering post-checkout, onboarding, upsell and cross-sell, loyalty and referral, list growth, and product launches, from ideation through readout

• Bring strong technical judgment to how complicated triggered communications, both marketing and transactional, should be set up for reliability, scale, and performance

• Support personalization across the full path to purchase

Execution & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Drive a rigorous test-and-learn agenda tied to company-level retention metrics (list growth, conversion, churn, LTV), partnering with Data & Analytics on experiment design, and keep a regular pulse on performance to turn what you find into next steps

• Serve as the go-to resource on the retention journey, staying close enough to every live program to speak to its setup, audience, logic, and results whenever it comes up

• Keep timelines and blockers visible to the team, flagging delays, scope changes, and open questions early and proactively

• Partner with Platform on the on-site experience and with CX on personalized moments like check-ins, so every touchpoint along the path to purchase feels connected

• Partner with Brand and Creative to keep every send

title: Representant(e) commercial(e) - Team lead - Clermont-Ferrand
description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Notre ancrage en France est déjà un succès incontestable. Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et recherchons nos prochains leaders sur le marché français.

L'OPPORTUNITÉ : SOYONS CLAIRS DÈS LE DÉPART

Ce poste n'est pas un poste de manager classique. Pendant les 6 premiers mois, tu es sur le terrain, en tant que commercial(e) à part entière avec des objectifs de vente individuels, comme chaque membre de l'équipe.

Pourquoi ? Parce que chez Salonkee, on ne peut diriger que ce que l'on maîtrise. Avant de coacher une équipe sur la prospection, les démos et le closing, tu dois connaître le marché, les salons et notre produit sur le bout des doigts. C'est notre garantie de qualité pour toi, pour ton équipe, et pour nos clients.

Si tu cherches un rôle de management à distance, derrière un tableau Excel, ce poste n'est pas fait pour toi. Si tu veux gagner ta légitimité sur le terrain avant de prendre les rênes, continue à lire.

TES MISSIONS

PHASE 1 : TU VENDS.

- Prospection terrain : Tu démarches activement les salons de coiffure et instituts de beauté de ta zone; porte-à-porte, démos en direct, closing.

- Objectifs individuels : Tu portes les mêmes objectifs de vente qu'un(e) commercial(e) terrain. Ta performance est mesurée, suivie, et récompensée.

- Apprentissage du marché : Tu comprends dans le détail les besoins des salons, les objections récurrentes et ce qui fait signer un·e gérant·e.

- Maîtrise des outils : CRM impeccable, pipeline propre, reporting fiable; tu appliques ce que tu exigeras plus tard de ton équipe.

PHASE 2 : TU CONSTRUIS ET TU DIRIGES.

- Constitution de ton équipe : Tu participes au recrutement et fais grandir ton équipe jusqu'à environ 5 personnes (et plus en cas de succès).

- Lead by example : Tu passes plus de 80 % de ton temps sur le terrain avec ton équipe; tu accompagnes et tu coaches la prospection, tu assistes aux démos et tu aides activement à transformer les opportunités en signatures.

- Structure & coaching : Tu organises la semaine, tu animes les 1:1 et les roleplays, tu lèves les obstacles rapidement et tu veilles à la rigueur du CRM de toute l'équipe.

- Pilotage par les chiffres : Tu connais les indicateurs clés de chaque membre de ton équipe et tu pilotes activement la performance.

- Culture & motivation : Tu crées des challenges d'équipe, tu renforces la culture sales et tu fais en sorte que chacun(e) progresse en continu.

TON PROFIL

- Passion pour la vente terrain : Au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience en vente terrain / commerce itinérant (le B2B est un plus). Tu adores être en première ligne.

- Potentiel de leadership : Tu n'as pas besoin d'avoir déjà été manager, mais tu as l'envie et le talent de prendre la responsabilité d'une région et de mener une équipe au succès.

- Autonomie & sens stratégique : Tu planifies tes activités en toute autonomie, tu fixes des priorités claires et trouves des moyens intelligents d'implanter Salonkee dans ta région.

- Affinité tech : Bonne compréhension des solutions digitales et solide expérience des CRM.

- Mobilité : Permis B indispensable, Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Clermont-Ferrand et alentours.

- Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales..

 

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

- Rémunération attractive : Un fixe solide + des commissions non plaf

Senior DevSecOps & Platform Engineering Lead
Full-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.S.) | Federal Civilian Practice | $180,000 to $210,000
The Problem We're Hiring You to Solve
A 20-year-old federal platform sits behind a home loan benefit that millions of American families depend on. Your job is to help retire it without anyone noticing.
You will own the DevSecOps and platform engineering ecosystem for a modernization program that runs legacy and modern stacks side by side: pipelines that move code from commit to production in under an hour, zero-downtime production deployments, environments built and torn down as code, and observability deep enough to explain a failure before the customer reports it. You will do this inside real federal security constraints, with real authority over how the engineering system works, and with AI as a first-class engineering tool.
The Opportunity
Most DevSecOps roles hand you an inherited pipeline and a backlog of tickets. This one hands you an engineering system to shape.
The program spans multiple applications, technology stacks, and platforms: a legacy suite that must stay stable and secure until it is decommissioned, and a modern cloud platform (Salesforce-centered, supplemented by serverless capabilities in a government cloud) where new capability lands every month. Production runs 24/7 against contractual availability targets. Releases ship to production at least monthly. Critical vulnerabilities must close in 30 days. The monitoring bar is full business transaction visibility, not “the server is up.”
You will lead the engineers who make all of that true. Not from a status meeting. From the architecture, the pipeline definitions, the incident bridge, and the customer conversation. You will decide how code moves from a developer's hands to production, how failures get detected and diagnosed, how security gets enforced without slowing delivery, and where automation and AI replace manual work.
The outcomes are measured, visible, and attached to a mission that matters. When deployments get faster and incidents get rarer, the customer sees it, and so do the people the program serves.
A note on the stack. If “Salesforce” made you hesitate, read this twice. You will not become a Salesforce administrator, and this role will not narrow your career. The application platform is Salesforce. The engineering system around it is not. The CI/CD architecture, environment automation, serverless cloud components, observability, security automation, legacy systems, and AI-enabled workflows are general-purpose platform engineering, and that is where you will spend your time. A strong platform engineer picks up the Salesforce-specific pieces quickly. The reverse is not true, which is why we are hiring for the former.
What You'll Own

• The delivery platform. Design and run CI/CD that lets teams move code from commit to production across multiple applications, stacks, and environments with minimal manual intervention. The standard: builds, tests, and deployments complete in under an hour, and production releases ship monthly or faster.

• Zero-downtime release engineering. Build deployment automation that verifies a release in production before users touch it, and rolls back cleanly when verification fails. Boring deployments are the goal.

• Environments as code. Automate provisioning so a complete environment stands up or tears down in days, not months, and configuration drift stops being a source of incidents.

• Security engineered into the pipeline. Make quality and security gates automatic, surface vulnerabilities early instead of at audit time, and drive remediation inside federal 30/60/90-day windows for critical, high, and medium findings. Support multi-year authorizations to operate and the program's Zero Trust alignment as engineering work, not paperwork theater.

title: Data Engineer – AI Value & DX Platform
description:
Founded in 1999 in Vienna, the Qualysoft Group is a manufacturer-independent IT consulting and services company, which successfully provides support for its international customers with the aim of boosting their competitiveness and economic efficiency through innovative IT solutions.
Its focus is on financial services providers, telecommunications companies, the automotive industry and energy service providers. Over 400 employees in 6 subsidiaries work together to ensure state of the art solutions for our clients.
We are looking for new colleagues in Qualysoft teams for diverse projects providing continuous learning opportunities. Our common goal is to provide honesty, development and a stable background while getting to know the latest technologies. We are waiting for your application for the position below!
Project Overview

The project focuses on the implementation of the DX platform (getdx.com) as a Proof of Concept (PoC), with a strong focus on objectively measuring the value generated by AI-assisted software development tools.

AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, coding agents, and AI-assisted code review solutions are increasingly being adopted. However, their actual business value is currently difficult to measure reliably.

The objective of the PoC is to assess whether AI adoption, usage intensity, development time savings, and the impact on quality and lead times can be reliably measured, integrated into existing systems, and used to support well-founded ROI, investment, and scaling decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Support the selection of pilot teams and the definition of an AI value measurement model.

• Define measurement and success criteria covering AI adoption, usage intensity, time savings, lead time, quality impact, and ROI.

• Set up and configure the DX platform, including SSO/identity integration and the permission model.

• Integrate DX with existing GitLab, CI/CD, ticketing, and identity/SSO systems.

• Integrate usage and telemetry data from the AI tools in use, including GitHub Copilot usage data / Copilot Metrics API.

• Configure teams, hierarchies, and data models within the DX platform.

• Set up and validate identity and team mapping across AI tools and delivery systems.

• Link AI-related metrics with relevant cost data.

• Set up the DX AI Measurement Framework surveys and system-side data collection.

• Establish baseline measurements before and after the expansion of AI usage.

• Analyze the impact of AI on quality-related metrics such as change failure rate, review effort, rework, and security findings, ensuring that AI value is not assessed solely in terms of speed.

• Ensure data quality, consistency, and completeness, including error analysis and correction.

• Implement technical requirements related to anonymization, aggregation, and data minimization.

• Ensure a clear separation between AI usage measurement and individual performance measurement.

• Develop dashboards, reports, and exports to support results analysis and ROI assessment.

• Identify the most effective AI use cases and key barriers to adoption based on the evaluation results.

• Support the definition of enablement measures and the future scaling and license strategy.

• Prepare technical documentation and estimate the effort and resources required for future scaling.

Why we think you will love working here:
With us you count as a person, our doors are always open.
We live the Qualysoft Team Spirit and stand for transparency!
Fresh wind and new ideas are welcome, because standstill is a foreign word at Qualysoft .

title: Senior Analyst - National Characterization
description:
Role Overview

The National Senior Characterization Analyst provides leadership for the acquisition, stewardship, analysis, and reporting of material characterization data across CAA states. This role establishes and maintains national standards for data quality, consistency, and comparability, ensuring characterization datasets support organizational reporting, strategic planning, and program evaluation. As the primary authority on characterization data governance, the position oversees the integrity and long-term usability of data generated through CAA characterization studies. The Senior Analyst will be on the Collection & Processing team within the Material Services department of Program Planning and Operations (PPO), which also includes Data & Analytics, Compliance & Regulatory Affairs, and Emerging States.

This position leads the development and maintenance of sort category frameworks across states, including the alignment of study-specific sort categories with state reporting requirements. The role evaluates waste characterization studies conducted by states and local jurisdictions to assess methodological alignment and opportunities for integration into CAA programs. The National Senior Characterization Analyst provides strategic oversight and guidance to CAA state teams to address data quality concerns, promote standardized practices, and ensure consistency with both national objectives and state-specific requirements.

In partnership with the CAA Data & Analytics team, this role oversees the integration of characterization data into enterprise data structures and analytical frameworks, ensuring data assets effectively support organizational reporting and decision-making needs. The position is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and continuously improving standard operating procedures related to data intake, quality assurance and quality control, data management, and long-term data governance, reinforcing accountability, consistency, and data integrity across characterization programs.

Key Responsibilities

Data Intake & Management

• Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of processes governing the intake and integration of waste characterization datasets, including new studies, legacy datasets, third-party data, and state-generated studies.

• Oversee data quality assurance activities, including the standardization, validation, and preparation of characterization data for incorporation into CAA systems and analytical platforms.

• Establish and maintain standards for metadata management, documentation, dataset assumptions, and version control to ensure transparency, consistency, and long-term data integrity.

Category Definitions & Study Alignment

• Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing refinement of national sort category frameworks, ensuring consistent application across CAA programs, state initiatives, and pilot studies.

• Provide oversight of category mapping methodologies, addressing state-specific reporting requirements, category discrepancies, and study-level variations to maintain data comparability and analytical consistency.

• Evaluate state and local waste characterization studies to assess methodological alignment, data suitability, and opportunities for integration into CAA characterization programs and reporting efforts.

Analysis, Metrics, and Reporting

• Provide leadership for the development and application of analytical methodologies used to calculate key CAA performance metrics, including contamination, capture, and recycling rates, leveraging validated characterization datasets.

• Direct comparative and trend analyses to identify emerging patterns, support cross-state benchmarking, and inform programmatic decision-making.

• Oversee the development of analytical summaries, data visualizations, and reporting deliverables that support internal stakeholders, strategic initiatives, and external reporting requirements.

title: Cost Accountant
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Cost Accountant to join our team.

Position Description

The Cost Accountant will play a key role in Oklo's accounting function, with primary responsibility over cost identification and coding for Oklo’s capital project spend, including for plant and inventory workstreams. This role partners closely with project controllers, procurement, accounts payable, and other stakeholders to make appropriate GAAP accounting conclusions for spend, including for capitalization and GL allocation of plant and fixed asset costs. The Cost Accountant will execute internal controls supporting Oklo's SOX environment, assist internal and external auditors, and deliver accurate monthly and quarterly close schedules. The ability to apply accounting policy consistently, investigate variances, and stay organized across a growing asset base will be a critical success factor.

A second critical aspect of this role will be managing and overseeing the Company's fixed assets register. This role will maintain the register and ensure assets are accurately classified, supported, and placed in service on a timely basis. The Cost Accountant will also run monthly depreciation, prepare related journal entries and roll-forwards, and reconcile the fixed asset subledger to the general ledger as part of the month-end close.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Partner with project controllers, procurement, accounts payable, and other stakeholders to review project spend for proper capitalization treatment under company policy.

• Maintain complete supporting documentation for capitalization conclusions, asset records, depreciation, and disposals in accordance with accounting policy and internal controls

• Support internal and external audits by providing fixed asset schedules, transaction support, control evidence, and timely responses to inquiries

• Partner with project controllers, procurement, and accounts payable to confirm asset descriptions, ownership, location, useful life, cost center, and placed-in-service status

• Align with project team for single source of truth related to capital project portfolio reporting as empowering projects teams to focus on progressing their projects

• Manage the capital project lifecycle, including additions, transfers, placed-in-service dates, disposals, retirements, and other changes to the fixed asset register

• Monitor construction-in-progress balances and coordinate the timely transfer of completed projects into the appropriate fixed asset categories

• Run monthly depreciation, validate system calculations, and prepare or post the related journal entries as part of the month-end close

• Reconcile the fixed asset subledger to the general ledger each month and research and resolve reconciling items promptly

• Prepare fixed asset journal entries for additions, transfers, disposals, impairments, reclassifications, and other required adjustments

• Prepare monthly and quarterly fixed asset roll-forwards, capital expenditure schedules, and related financial reporting support

• Coordinate periodic physical inventories and asset verification procedures and investigate identified discrepancies

• Identify opportunities to improve and automate fixed asset accounting, capitalization review, reconciliation, and reporting processes

• Support other accounting responsibilities and special projects as assigned as the Company's operations and asset base continue to grow

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including fixed asset or cost accounting responsibilities

• Experience managing fixed asset additions, depreciation, disposals, reconciliations, and capitalization assessments

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, fixed asset accounting principles, and Microsoft Excel

Bonus Qualifications:

• Experience using NetSuite and NetAsset fixed asset management software

title: Technical Lead Manager, Pullover Manuevers
locationText: Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo is rapidly scaling its driving technology to new cities and geographies. A continual focus on operational efficiency, compliance, and safety is critical to this mission. The Driver Refinement & Validation organization builds the technology and tools to rapidly discover, iterate, and mitigate complex vehicle behaviors while scaling performance in a data-driven way.

The PUDOs (Pick-up/Drop-off) team is directly responsible for perfecting how our fully autonomous car executes pullovers-improving key driving scenarios like passenger pick-ups and drop-offs, parking, and deliveries. As we expand, our goal is to build the advanced signals and software necessary to seamlessly scale the Waymo Driver's performance across these critical real-world touchpoints in every new market.

In this role, you will report to a Technical Lead Manager. 

You will:

• Work closely with Technical Leads  and Technical Lead Managers  in the org to design and implement horizontal solutions to solve behavioral driving across PUDOs (pick up & drop off)

• Build quantitative evaluation techniques of on-road performance to drive data-driven development

• Work closely with partners across Product and the Onboard stack

• Provide mentorship for junior engineers on the team

• Develop foundational frameworks that help advancement of the Waymo Driver's capabilities

• Directly contribute to solving some of the most challenging driving situations in the long tail

You have:

• PhD, Masters, or Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics

• 8+ years of Software Engineering experience in complex systems

• Evaluation experience, contributing to scalable eval workflows and building metrics for ML models and analyzing large datasets

• High quality API design with an eye towards evaluation and data-driven techniques

• Experience with working and solving design problems that span multiple components

• Ability to collaborate within and across teams

• Two or more years of management experience

We prefer:

• AV or Robotics experience

• Experience with Machine Learning models in production systems

• Coding proficiency in C++, Python, and SQL

title: Software Engineer, Research Tools
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on the RL Data team, you’ll design and build the tools that researchers and external contributors use to create, review, submit, and monitor the environments and tasks behind Cursor’s reinforcement-learning runs. This is a full-stack product-engineering role embedded in a research team.

You’ll own the review and acceptance experience end to end: from rollout and transcript inspection, task-quality signals grader and reward-hacking analysis, to the workflows that move a submission into training. From there, you’ll build authoring interfaces that let researchers, vendors, and domain experts create and improve environments and tasks quickly and confidently.

Your work will significantly shorten the loop from a task idea or data sources, to candidate task, to trusted training data.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

- Create fast, trustworthy workflows for vendors and research team to interact effectively with each other - vendor task creation and iteration, vendor submissions, and task acceptance into training.

- Build review tools for inspecting and comparing rollouts, transcripts, grader outputs, and other signals of task quality.

- Develop environment-health, failure-search, versioning, and catalog experiences that make training data easy to understand, manage, and extend.

- Establish a shared component kit, then use it to build self-serve interfaces for creating and improving tasks with quality checks inline.

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You’ve shipped full-stack products and owned systems from user interface through storage or services, using technologies such as TypeScript and React alongside Node, Python, or Go.

- You’ve built dense, data-facing tools such as transcript viewers, diffing systems, review queues, observability products, or operational dashboards-and you have strong opinions about how structured data should be rendered.

- You’ve built or maintained a design system or component library and can establish durable product and engineering conventions for a fast-moving team.

- You’ve designed review, QA, moderation, fraud, or acceptance workflows where users had an incentive to get past the checks, and you know how to keep those systems honest.

- You care about data quality, and are willing to inspect raw data. Experience with evaluations, graders, reinforcement learning, or data-quality systems is helpful but not required.

- You move quickly under ambiguity, collaborate closely with researchers and domain experts, and take open-ended problems from rough need to reliable product.

APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we’ll schedule two or three short technical interviews focused on frontend craft for dense data and system design for a review-and-acceptance workflow. After that, we’ll invite you onsite to work on a small project using real rollouts, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

title: Senior Research Scientist, Magnets
description:
ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Introduction to the team: The Magnets team is one of several research verticals within SandboxAQ's broader Chemical Simulation group, which uses advanced computational methods, physics-based simulation, and AI to discover and develop novel materials. Within that effort, the Magnets vertical is focused on one of the most strategically important materials problems today: developing high-performance permanent magnets that reduce or eliminate reliance on neodymium and other rare earth elements and can be manufactured in the United States. Our goal is to create novel magnet formulations that use existing industry processes and equipment while matching or exceeding the performance of today's leading NdFeB magnets in demanding applications such as semiconductor equipment, vacuum systems, precision motion devices, and defense technologies.

Introduction to the role: We are seeking a Research Scientist to help drive the computational discovery and optimization of next-generation magnet materials. The ideal candidate has a strong background in applying first-principles and multi-scale reference systems, computational simulation, together with machine learning, to magnetic and intermetallic materials. In this role you will (1) run and interpret atomistic and multi-scale simulations that predict the properties of magnets materials, (2) build and deploy computational and ML-driven workflows that screen rare-earth-lean and rare-earth-free candidates at scale, (3) work with experimental collaborators to test and refine predictions against real-world data, and (4) contribute to the project plans, publications, and IP of the vertical. You will report to the Chief Scientist, Magnets and work closely with our AI simulation platform and data-generation teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Execute, analyze, and document DFT and multi-scale reference systems to predict phase stability, magnetocrystalline anisotropy, saturation magnetization, Curie temperature, and other properties across Fe- and Co-based intermetallic systems using U.S.-accessible alloying elements.

- Develop and test computational workflows and ML interatomic potentials / surrogate models that enable high-throughput screening and optimization of rare-earth-lean and rare-earth-free permanent magnet candidates.

- Lead high-fidelity data generation campaigns that feed the magnetism-aware LQM; work with platform and data-generation teams to specify the energetics, descriptors, and uncertainty estimates the workflows require.

- Connect atomistic simulation outputs to microstructure- and process-level predictions (powder metallurgy, sintering, heat treatment) to keep candidate formulations manufacturable with existing industry equipment.

Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England.
Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services - and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

We’re looking for an organised and detail-focused individual who can manage financial and administrative responsibilities accurately and confidentially.

You’ll be able to prioritise your workload in a busy environment, manage competing demands and ensure deadlines are met.
Experience in a customer care, healthcare, education or social care environment would be valuable, alongside previous clerical, administrative or reception experience.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
We’re hiring a Business Development Manager (full-cycle IC) to launch and validate a new B2B sales motion in the Polish hotel market. This is an MVP role: rather than executing an already-proven playbook, you’ll be the first person testing whether and how hotels buy our Hotel Profit Audit and wider Hotel Profit Management services/solutions - who the real decision-makers are, which messages and channels work, and whether a repeatable sales funnel emerges.
You’ll own the full cycle - prospecting, outreach, discovery, meetings, follow-up and eventually closing the first pilot clients - and report directly to the business owner driving this initiative, with coordination on the BnBerry side.
In the first 90 days, success will be defined by:
1) Researching accounts and identifying real decision-makers (owners/GMs)
2) Booking qualified discovery meetings
3) Keeping disciplined, complete CRM records
4) Capturing structured market feedback (objections, pricing sensitivity, effective messaging) to validate the offer and funnel
You’ll sell into hospitality buyers (owners, GMs) and should bring genuine outbound B2B sales discipline, even if you haven’t sold into hospitality before.
Requirements
Must-have experience & profile

• 2-5 years in B2B sales / business development, with genuine hands-on cold-outbound experience (not inbound-only)

• Core skills: prospecting and independently identifying decision-makers, cold calling, email/LinkedIn outreach, discovery, consultative selling

• Strong CRM discipline: accurate contacts, clear next steps, call summaries, verified decision-makers

• Polish: C1 / native - mandatory
• English: B2+ - mandatory

• Working style: independent, disciplined, curious, analytical, resilient to rejection

• Comfortable capturing structured market feedback, not just selling - able to explain your own funnel and reasoning, not just execute a script

• Comfortable operating without an established playbook, in a fully remote, no-office setup, with occasional fully company-paid travel to hotel meetings

Nice to have

• Hospitality / hotel-tech / PMS / channel manager / OTA / revenue-tech background - preferred, though strong outbound B2B experience matters more than industry background

• Prior experience selling a new or pre-validated product at MVP / early-stage

• Russian: B2+ - materially improves speed and quality of direct feedback and internal discussion.

What “good” looks like

• Comfortable with sustained daily outbound activity (calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach and follow-ups)

• Able to explain your own funnel and numbers without checking notes: accounts researched, contacts reached, conversations, qualified meetings, reasons lost

• Full-cycle ownership: contacts → conversations → qualified meetings → audit interest → proposal → pilot / contract

• What we weigh most when hiring: real outbound B2B experience and prospecting/decision-maker identification come first, followed by discovery skills, language requirements, independence and CRM discipline - hospitality knowledge is a smaller, nice-to-have factor

• Automatic no: no cold-outbound experience, inbound-only background, expecting a ready-made database or script, dislike of CRM, inability to explain a previous funnel, not speaking fluent Polish, or pitching on a mock call instead of running discovery

Benefits
• Fully remote / online - no office

• Business trips for hotel meetings may be required and are fully paid by the company

• Full-time/Part-time option can also be discussed

Plaid's TechOps team is the technical foundation that is a major stakeholder in keeping the company running. We own the systems, tools, and infrastructure that every Plaid employee depends on from identity and endpoint management to help desk support, office infrastructure, and the internal tooling that powers day-to-day productivity.

What sets us apart from a traditional IT team is how we approach the higher level goals we have to improve our systems and tooling over time. title: Freelance Senior Backend Engineer (all genders)
description:
ABOUT BABBEL LABS

Babbel Labs is building the future of language learning. We are an AI-first, independent company within the Babbel group, based in Berlin. Our teams bring AI, research and product together to ship experiences that set a new standard for how people learn.

THE ROLE

Babbel Labs is rebuilding how learning content is created, stored and served, and how we decide what a learner sees next. The architecture for that is being set now, by a small number of engineers, and this role is one of them.

You will build and run the services behind it, in a serverless-first TypeScript and Node stack on AWS, owning them from the contract at their edge to their behaviour under load.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will design, build, ship and operate, and the seniority shows in the decisions you own rather than in a team reporting to you.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

- Build and evolve services across our learning platform, owning each one from its API contract through to what runs in production.

- Take on services you did not write, alongside the people who did.

- Design API and data contracts that hold up over time, with type-safe transforms between the API, the domain and persistence.

- Run what you build. Instrument it, know how it fails, change live data safely, and be the person who works out why it broke.

- Deliver with coding agents as a matter of course, and verify what they produce before you rely on it.

YOUR SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- Strong, hands-on backend engineering in TypeScript and Node as your primary working language today. We mean back-end services: not build tooling, and not the server a front-end framework happens to ship with.

- Deep, practical AWS experience in a serverless-first setting. Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB and event streaming are our daily tools, and we want someone who has designed against them rather than only deployed onto them.

- The ability to design API and data contracts and to model a domain, including type-safe transforms at the boundaries between the API, the domain and persistence.

- Real production ownership. You have instrumented your own services, understood their failure modes, changed live data without losing any, and worked incidents on systems you owned.

- Coding agents are part of your daily workflow, and you check their output before you rely on it. You are neither dismissive of them nor careless with them.

- Self-sufficiency. You get yourself unstuck in an unfamiliar codebase without a minder, and you work within its grain rather than rewriting what you have not yet understood.

- Working familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines, enough to ship and change your own service's delivery. This is not an infrastructure role, so depth here is not the bar.

- Python as a welcome secondary language. Some of our services are Python, and a Labs engineer can expect to touch them.

NICE TO HAVE

- Go or Rust for performance-critical components. Fully optional.

- Experience with a monorepo build system and shared tooling.

- Public technical work, such as open-source contributions or writing.

WAYS OF WORKING

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on a small team that moves fast, agent-first, but with a structured and disciplined delivery approach. It is remote and Berlin-friendly. The interview process is deliberately short: an initial screen, followed by one working session with the hiring manager.

- Shape how AI is used responsibly in education.

- Collaborate with experienced product, engineering, and language experts.

- Flexible working models, learning budgets, and free language learning.

- An inclusive, supportive environment that values curiosity and growth.
